adjudication.rationale: The diff shows the same pattern added repeatedly to adapt to `destinationCalendar` becoming an array, e.g. `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` (or similar) in multiple places: GoogleCalendarService (createEvent/updateEvent), LarkCalendarService (createEvent/createAttendees/updateEvent/deleteEvent), Office365CalendarService (createEvent), BaseCalendarService (at least two locations), EventManager (location fallback), and BrokenIntegrationEmail. This is not a correctness defect by itself, but it is a concrete maintainability/architecture issue introduced by the change: the “main host destination calendar” selection logic is duplicated across services, increasing the risk of future inconsistencies. Extracting a shared helper (e.g., `getMainHostDestinationCalendar(event)`) would address this.
